rows.code: size on SelectTrigger — default · sm, the trigger height
no prop — live state: focus = :focus-visible · disabled = disabled · invalid = aria-invalid · focus-invalid = focus + invalid (no filled state, unlike Input/Textarea)
placeholder on SelectValue — shown while no value is selected
value / defaultValue — shows the currently selected item's label; value is controlled, defaultValue uncontrolled
no prop — live state: on = value / defaultValue set (Figma property name is a typo for "filled", not renamed here)
onValueChange: (value: string) => void — called when the selection changes
open: boolean — controlled open state; Figma is a static composition and can’t represent live open/close (see the Open example)
defaultOpen: boolean — open state when uncontrolled; default false
onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void — called when the dropdown opens or closes
required: boolean — marks the select required for native form validation; default false, no visual difference
name: string — form field name submitted with the form; no visual representation
